assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, setbacks), road redlines, ownership, municipal utility capacity and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before any statutory use. The proposal records such metrics as unknown and uses low-confidence conceptual massing instead.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission on the provided provisional boundary and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are the repository's provisional rough geometry. All area-sensitive metrics are recalculable from the submitted geometry and must be fully recalculated once official polygons are published.
assumptions.impact: Provisional geometry must never be cited as an official redline or precise-area basis; content scoring remains eligible under the organizer's data-gap rule.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, conceptual floors and conceptual GFA are design-model outputs generated on design parcels. They are not survey data, statutory values or engineering schemes.
assumptions.impact: Conceptual volumes must not be quoted as approved scale; they only indicate order-of-magnitude spatial supply.

assumptions.statement: Metro node positions and rail corridor hints are indicative common-knowledge approximations pending official alignment, entrance and safety-zone data.
assumptions.impact: No bridge, tunnel or underground engineering feasibility conclusion is drawn anywhere in the package.
